mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wf_task WHERE status = 'TODO' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT AVG(duration) FROM wf_process_monitor WHERE status IN ('PASSED', 'AUTO_PASSED') AND end_time IS NOT NULL AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('PASSED', 'AUTO_PASSED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) * 100 ELSE 0 END FROM wf_process_monitor WHERE status IN ('PASSED', 'AUTO_PASSED', 'FAILED', 'TERMINATED', 'REJECTED', 'INVALIDATED', 'CANCELLED') AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT p.id, p.tenant_id, p.instance_id, p.business_key, p.duration, p.node_count, p.start_user_id, p.start_user_name, p.error_message, p.version, p.update_time, p.process_def_id, p.process_def_key, p.process_def_name as process_name, p.status, p.start_time, p.end_time, COALESCE(p.duration, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, p.start_time, NOW()) * 1000) as duration_ms, p.task_count, p.task_count as completed_task_count, p.start_user_name as initiator, p.start_user_name as initiator_name, p.create_time FROM wf_process_monitor p WHERE p.instance_id = #{instanceId}
AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT p.id, p.tenant_id, p.instance_id, p.process_def_id, p.process_def_key, p.process_def_name as process_name, p.status, p.start_time, p.end_time, COALESCE(p.duration, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, p.start_time, NOW()) * 1000) as duration_ms, p.task_count, p.task_count as completed_task_count, p.start_user_name as initiator, p.start_user_name as initiator_name, p.create_time, i.dept_id AS dept_id, p.start_user_id AS start_user_id FROM wf_process_monitor p LEFT JOIN wf_process_instance i ON i.instance_id = p.instance_id AND i.tenant_id = p.tenant_id WHERE p.instance_id = #{instanceId}
AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT p.id, p.tenant_id, p.instance_id, p.process_def_id, p.process_def_key, p.process_def_name as process_name, p.status, p.start_time, p.end_time, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, p.start_time, NOW()) * 1000 as duration_ms, p.task_count, p.task_count as completed_task_count, p.start_user_name as initiator, p.start_user_name as initiator_name, p.create_time FROM wf_process_monitor p WHERE p.status IN ('RUNNING', 'WITHDRAWN', 'TASK_BACK', 'RESTARTED', 'PENDING') AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY p.start_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.tenant_id, p.instance_id, p.process_def_id, p.process_def_key, p.process_def_name as process_name, p.status, p.start_time, p.end_time, COALESCE(p.duration, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, p.start_time, NOW()) * 1000) as duration_ms, p.task_count, p.task_count as completed_task_count, p.start_user_name as initiator, p.start_user_name as initiator_name, p.create_time FROM wf_process_monitor p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.process_def_key = #{processDefKey} ORDER BY p.start_time DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
